name: easy-mcps
description: 数据库 MCP 服务器集合 - 统一权限控制

scripts.build: npm run sync && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build && node scripts/check-sync.mjs && node scripts/test-validate.mjs
scripts.release:mysql: npm run sync && cd mysql-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:postgresql: npm run sync && cd postgresql-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:clickhouse: npm run sync && cd clickhouse-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:sqlite: npm run sync && cd sqlite-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:tidb: npm run sync && cd tidb-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:oceanbase: npm run sync && cd oceanbase-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:mariadb: npm run sync && cd mariadb-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:starrocks: npm run sync && cd starrocks-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:redis: cd redis-mcp && npm version patch --no-git-tag-version && npm run build && npm publish --access public
scripts.release:all: npm test && npm run release:mysql && npm run release:postgresql && npm run release:clickhouse && npm run release:sqlite && npm run release:tidb && npm run release:oceanbase && npm run release:mariadb && npm run release:starrocks && npm run release:redis
